anomaly_flag.note: A round is flagged when its fresh designs sit on average more than 0.5 pKD from where the model put them. 0.5 pKD is a three-fold change in apparent KD and 3.3 times the assay's noise sigma, so it is a discrepancy a scientist would stop for. Signed and not two-sided-scattered: a batch chosen by expected improvement always lands where the model is least certain, so an interval miss rate fires on every round and carries no information. A run offset and a real activity cliff trip this statistic identically, which is the point -- the flag says a round needs deciding, never which explanation wins.

batch.round1_policy_note: Round 1 is a single-mutant scan: every editable position, six substitutions each, chosen round-robin so the surrogate sees every position before it has to reason about combinations. The scan residues span chemistry -- A small, D acidic, K basic, S polar, L aliphatic, W aromatic -- which is how a protein engineer lays out a CDR scan. Restricting round 1 to singles also makes it structurally incapable of reaching the threshold, since no single mutant in the pool can.

diagnostics_policy.note: Tolerances for the diagnostic library, declared by the template rather than chosen while reading a round. The bridge is the same molecules measured twice, so its members should differ only by read noise: a spread wider than 2.0 x the round's own read-noise scale means they are telling different stories and there is no single number to correct by. 3.0 x that scale flags a construct whose two reads disagree, which over a batch of 48 expects about one false flag every eight rounds. Coverage is split into 4 bins and not deciles because a coverage estimate needs enough designs per bin to tell 0.8 from 0.5: at a batch of 48, quartiles give about twelve designs each, while deciles give five and quantize coverage to multiples of 0.2.

objectives.name: hydrophobicity
objectives.note: Normalized Kyte-Doolittle over the editable window. Threshold sits marginally above the parent at 0.507: the lead is an approved therapeutic, so the design rule is not to become more aggregation-prone than the molecule that already works.

objectives.name: liability_count
objectives.note: Counts motifs the variant introduces relative to the parent. The parent's own DG is inherited, not introduced.
